doc_kind: medical policy (adopts Evolent clinical guideline 1756; BSC_EVO_1756)
lines_of_business: Not stated; benefit application defers to member contract
sections_in_order: Policy Statement (indications, spondyloarthropathy, imaging guidance, diagnostic purposes, repeat injections, exclusions, contraindications)
criteria_location: Policy Statement pp.1-3; HEP definition in Policy Guidelines p.3; new-episode rule ('Special Note') buried in Rationale p.6.
procedures_covered: Intra-articular or ligamentous SI joint injections (CPT 27096, HCPCS G0260)
Excluded: sacral lateral branch blocks, RF denervation of SI joint

logic.top_level: pathways (SI joint pain; spondyloarthropathy; diagnostic for surgical planning), with repeat-injection rules layered on

k_of_n.quote: A cluster of any three (3) of the following positive provocation exam findings
Inflammatory back pain evidence with at least 4 of the following criteria present

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate EXCLUSIONS (lateral branch blocks, RF) and CONTRAINDICATIONS lists split into absolute (active systemic or spinal infection, skin infection, local malignancy, septic joint) and relative (coagulopathy, pregnancy, uncontrollable diabetes, blood thinners). Relative ones have no stated consequence.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Initial phase up to 2 injections >= 2 weeks apart with >= 50% relief or significant functional improvement; therapeutic phase needs >= 50% relief 'for a minimum of 2 months', pain >= 6/10 or disability, ongoing active conservative treatment, repeat positive provocative finding after other spine injections, max 4 per 12 months per region. New episode of care after 2 years.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: at least 50% pain relief or significant documented functional improvement
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'or' between a percentage and an undefined functional judgment

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Pain causing functional disability or average pain level of ≥ 6
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: functional disability undefined; either path suffices

and_or_ambiguity.quote: for a minimum of 6 weeks in the last 6 months unless the medical reason ... is clearly documented; OR details of active engagement in ongoing non-operative conservative treatment if the individual has had prior spinal injections
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The OR is a sub-bullet; applies only to people with prior injections, not stated as an exception.

requirement_kinds.quote: Primarily axial low back pain (below level of L5) which may radiate to the groin or lower extremity
Pain causing functional disability or average pain level of ≥ 6 on a scale of 0 to 10
A cluster of any three (3) of the following positive provocation exam findings (distraction, compression, sacral thrust, FABER, posterior shear, Yeoman's, Gaenslen's, thigh thrust)
Duration of pain of at least 3 months
Failure to respond to non-operative conservative treatment ... for a minimum of 6 weeks in the last 6 months
evidence of sacroiliitis on imaging (active inflammation on MRI or radiographic sacroiliitis grade 2-4 bilaterally or grade 3-4 unilaterally)
Positive testing for HLA-B27; Elevated C-reactive protein (CRP)
Spondyloarthropathy track: age of onset < 45 years, >= 3 months low back pain
At least 75% pain relief for the expected duration of the anesthetic after each diagnostic injection
Documentation of a pre-operative evaluation and plan for SIJ surgery
ALL procedures must be performed under imaging guidance; In person provocative exam required (no telehealth)
Each sacroiliac joint injection requires an authorization

thresholds.quote: average pain level of ≥ 6 on a scale of 0 to 10
A maximum of 4 sacroiliac joint injections may be performed in a 12-month period per region

time_windows.quote: Duration of pain of at least 3 months
for a minimum of 6 weeks in the last 6 months
for a minimum of 2 months before each therapeutic injection
at least two years from prior injections in the same region

external_dependencies.quote: They are in keeping with the benefit guidelines developed by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).
criteria developed by the Assessment of SpondyloArthritis International Society (ASAS)

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Documentation of an exercise prescription/plan provided by a physician, physical therapist, or chiropractor AND Follow-up documentation regarding completion of HEP after the required 6-week timeframe

vague_terms.quote: non-operative conservative treatment targeting the requested spinal region
engaged in ongoing active conservative treatment

extraction_hazards: Criteria carry superscript reference numbers like (1,2,3,4) that look like data
Spondyloarthropathy list splits across the page 1-2 break
Special Note (new episode of care after 2 years) is in Rationale, not Policy Statement
Appendix-style 'Refer to Appendix A' mention but none on policy
Eight-test list uses 'thigh thrust' vs 'Thigh Thrust test' naming variations
interesting_structures: k-of-n inside a pathway: 3 of 8 provocative tests; 4 of 5 inflammatory back pain criteria nested in 1+ of 11 features
Repeat-injection requires fresh provocative exam only if other injections intervened
Identical text to Evolent guideline 1756: payer adopts vendor criteria verbatim

fit_to_tree.why: Nested all/any/k-of-n expresses it well; difficulty is stateful (injection history, relief durations, episode reset) and undefined functional terms.
